summary: Coverage mode on 10 backend targets. Created 5 test files (health, config, database, factory, lifespan) and extended router.test.ts. Mappers, repository and validators were already fully covered, so I skipped them, and I skipped main.ts as a bootstrap file. The new and changed tests pass, typecheck is clean, and the full backend suite passes.

decisions.reason: The health endpoint had no test.
scenarios: reports ok after querying the database

uses DATABASE_URL when no override is given

serves the health endpoint

decisions.reason: Already covered by tests/mappers.test.ts: mapping, an absent due date and invalid stored data are all exercised.
Already covered by tests/repository.test.ts: every method and branch is exercised, including empty and unknown update fields and missing rows.
The existing tests only covered list and create. GET, PATCH and DELETE by id, the id validation and the 404 paths were untested.
scenarios: gets a task by ID
returns 404 when getting a missing task
rejects invalid ID with 422

decisions.reason: Already covered by tests/validators.test.ts: defaults, trimming, boundaries, rejections, id parsing and the response schema.
Process bootstrap with no extractable logic. It only calls start() and sets the exit code on failure, and start() is covered by lifespan.test.ts.

notes: The first lifespan.test.ts run had 4 failures, caused by my fake app.listen calling its callback synchronously. I fixed the test and it now passes.
The typecheck command finished with no errors, so I recorded it with 0 passed and 0 failed, since it reports no test counts.
